question: In the fixed synthetic joint economy, does doubling the loss-side reserve response alter the effect of a security mark shock on goods consumption at the first affected decision period?
root_sampling: First eight primes greater than 100, declared before execution. Each root is a distinct AddressedRNG world replication on the same registered population and network.

primary_endpoint.definition: Sum of goods units removed by successful consumption settlements in period 3 across all eight registered households. Households without settlement contribute zero.
primary_endpoint.source: Consumption journal transactions matched to receipts and the committed period aggregate.

analysis.unit: one complete root with four paired worlds
analysis.diagnostics: No p-values. Mean, sample SD, MCSE and two-sided nominal 95% Student t interval across eligible roots. Interval unavailable for n < 2 or zero observed SD. Retain assigned denominators and reasons for ineligibility.
analysis.purpose: Feasibility and observed finite-sample variance only.

information_matching.policy_control: Weight 1 uses exactly the same observation channel as weight 2. Peer disclosure and its attention limit remain active in all arms.
information_matching.primary_gate: Require exact period-3 observation equality within each same-mark weight pair and equal observation counts by actor and channel across all arms. The predecision wealth fact value is the intended price intervention.
information_matching.later_periods: Realized disclosures and resulting information counts can be outcomes after period 3. Report them with denominators. Use the first-barrier information-matched contrast for inference.

missingness.realized_returns: Use adjacent realized security closes only. Null if either close is missing. A synthetic mark and the opening reference price cannot supply a realized close.
missingness.terminal: Retain failed, not started, audit failed, or natural stop assignments. Use completed roots satisfying frozen pairing and manipulation checks. No replacement or additional seeds.
missingness.institutional_response: A recorded fiscal zero or nontriggered response remains an outcome.

risks: Cash floors may make both weights choose the same action.
One prefunded security session leaves adjacent realized market returns unobserved.
Fixed topology, short horizon and eight addressed roots limit generalization.
Public-goods calibration covers observed cooperation transitions only. This pilot has no matching empirical data.
